checkRuns.command: sed -i "s|// \`bun run start\` serves the build with Bun, so use its built-in SQLite.|// Built-in SQLite (\`node:sqlite\`): Node.js runs the build, Bun serves it.|; s|sqliteConnector: 'bun'|sqliteConnector: 'native'|" nuxt.config.ts; cat nuxt.config.ts; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -30

sed -i "s|const route = useRoute('books-slug')|const route = useRoute()|; s|const slug = computed(() => route.params.slug)|const slug = computed(() => String(route.params.slug))|" 'app/pages/books/[slug].vue'; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -10 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -15

kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f ".output/server/index.mjs"; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -10 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2 && (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/bookshelf.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3
for p in / /books/nope /nope /about/x /books/dracula; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -D /tmp/h -o /tmp/o http://127.0.0.1:4701$p; head -1 /tmp/h; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o; python3 /tmp/body.py < /tmp/o | head -c 900; echo; done
node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:4701/nope').then(async r=>{console.log(r.status, r.headers.get('content-type'))})"
ps aux | grep "[i]ndex.mjs"; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -10 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2
sed -i 's|:href="href"|:href="href ?? undefined"|' app/layouts/default.vue; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -10 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
kill $(cat /tmp/server.pid); bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1; grep -l "readBody\|H3Error" .output/public/_nuxt/*.js | head
kill $(cat /tmp/server.pid); bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun add -d happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1; grep version node_modules/happy-dom/package.json

bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1 && (PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/bookshelf.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/server.pid); sleep 3
for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /books/nope /nope /about /contact /__nuxt_content/books/sql_dump.txt; do printf "%s %s %s\n" "$(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Accept: text/html' http://127.0.0.1:4702$p)" "$p" "$(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o)"; done
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -d "name=&email=&message=" http://127.0.0.1:4702/contact
curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"x","email":"a@b.co","message":"12345678901234567890"}' http://127.0.0.1:4702/api/contact; echo
kill $(cat /tmp/server.pid); sleep 1; ps aux | grep "[.]output/server" || echo "no server running"; cat /tmp/bookshelf.log; git status --short

otherRuntimes: cat content/books/frankenstein.md content/books/dracula.md; cat app/app.vue nuxt.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls public docs/raw; bun --version; node --version; grep -il "content" docs/raw -r | head -30

cat > /tmp/body.py <<'EOF'
import sys,re
s=sys.stdin.read()
m=re.search(r'<div id="__nuxt">(.*?)<div id="teleports">',s,re.S)
print(re.sub(r'<!--.*?-->|data-v-\w+','',m.group(1)) if m else s[:500])
EOF

node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:4701/nope').then(async r=>{console.log(r.status, r.headers.get('content-type')); console.log((await r.text()).slice(0,200))})"; curl -s -H 'Accept: text/html' http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/nope | python3 /tmp/body.py

mkdir -p app/components app/types cat > app/components/NotFoundPage.vue <<'EOF' EOF cat > 'app/pages/[...slug].vue' <<'EOF' EOF cat > app/types/page-meta.d.ts <<'EOF' declare module '#app' { interface PageMeta { /** The page answers with the 404 page, so no section of the nav is current. */ notFound?: boolean } } export {} EOF cat > app/error.vue <<'EOF' EOF cat > 'app/pages/books/[slug].vue' <<'EOF' EOF python3 - <<'EOF' p='app/layouts/default.vue' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace(''' if (error.value) return false''',''' if (error.value || route.meta.notFound) return false''') s=s.replace(''' Bookshelf''',''' Bookshelf ''') s=s.replace(''' {{ link.label }}''',''' {{ link.label }} ''') open(p,'w').write(s) EOF cat app/layouts/default.vue | head -45
